req.title: Emit Swagger UI
req.statement: The system shall serve interactive Swagger UI documentation at GET /docs.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-018 requires GET /docs to serve interactive Swagger UI documentation with an HTTP 2xx response. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — valid GET /docs returns 200 with HTML content containing Swagger UI markers; (2) negative NEG — wrong HTTP method (POST) on /docs returns 405; (3) boundary BVA — exact status code 200 (not 201, not 199) and exact Content-Type header containing 'text/html'; (4) DT — verifying the response body contains specific Swagger UI identifiers ('swagger-ui', 'openapi') to catch mutations that serve a different page; (5) STC — verifying the app title from main.py appears in the docs page, confirming the correct FastAPI app instance is wired. All tests use TestClient in-process, assert exact values, and are designed to kill constant-mutation, operator-flip, and boolean-negation mutants.

tests.name: test_get_docs_returns_200_with_html
preconditions: FastAPI app is instantiated with lifespan and routers included
trace: R-PLAYER-018: GET /docs shall return HTTP 2xx with expected payload
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_docs_returns_200_with_html():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/docs')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert 'text/html' in r.headers['content-type']
    assert len(r.content) > 0

test_get_docs_returns_200_with_html()

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_docs_body_contains_swagger_ui_markers():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/docs')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.text.lower()
    assert 'swagger-ui' in body
    assert 'openapi' in body

test_get_docs_body_contains_swagger_ui_markers()

tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_docs_content_type_is_text_html_not_json():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/docs')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers['content-type']
    assert 'text/html' in ct
    assert 'application/json' not in ct

test_get_docs_content_type_is_text_html_not_json()
